advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the det_measurement_provenance docstring's multi-line provenance example with the single-line form the parser actually accepts (either collapse the docstring example to one line or make `_find_provenance_line`/`_parse_provenance` join indented continuation lines).
evidence: Docstring shows wrapped form: `          provenance: environment=<v>; principal=<v>; privilege_posture=<v>; instrument=<v>` then a separate line `          — <justification>` (det_measurement_provenance.py:14-16)

`_find_provenance_line` returns only the first matching `stripped` line: `if _PROVENANCE_LINE_RE.match(stripped): return stripped` (det_measurement_provenance.py:100-101) — no joining of subsequent indented continuation lines
`_parse_provenance` requires the em-dash on that same line: `if "—" in rest: body, justification = rest.split("—", 1) else: body, justification = rest, ""` (det_measurement_provenance.py:108-111)
ADR Decision block and all tests use the SINGLE-line form (`provenance: ... instrument=<v> — <justification>`), so the impl matches the ADR/tests but contradicts its own module docstring
advisory.finding: The det_measurement_provenance module docstring documents a WRAPPED provenance declaration where the em-dash justification appears on its own indented continuation line, but the parser only reads the single line beginning with `provenance:` and splits it on the em-dash — so a plan following the docstring's own multi-line example produces an empty justification and is falsely flagged 'justification is missing or a placeholder value'.
advisory.suggested_fix: Change the module docstring example (lines 14-16) to keep the `provenance:` fields and the `— <justification>` on the SAME logical line, matching the ADR/prompt and the parser.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Fix the det_measurement_provenance.py docstring example so the em-dash justification is inline on the same `provenance:` line, matching the parser and ADR-0061/prompt.
evidence: Docstring example: `provenance: environment=<v>; principal=<v>; privilege_posture=<v>; instrument=<v>` then on the next line `          — <justification>`
Parser: `_find_provenance_line` returns the first line beginning `provenance:`; `_parse_provenance(rest)` splits only that line's `rest` on `—` — a justification on a following line is never seen
ADR-0061 and the prompt both show the justification INLINE: `... instrument=<live-call|simulation|static-analysis> — <justification>`
advisory.finding: The module docstring in det_measurement_provenance.py documents the provenance declaration with the em-dash justification on a SEPARATE continuation line, but the parser only reads the single line beginning with `provenance:` and splits that one line on `—`. A user following the docstring example (justification on its own line) would have their justification not parsed, triggering a spurious 'justification is missing' gap.
scenarios: An author copies the two-line format from the module docstring and is flagged for a missing justification despite providing one.
advisory.suggested_fix: Change the docstring example to put `— <justification>` on the same line as the `provenance:` key, consistent with ADR-0061 and the rubric prompt.
